title: Elysian Fields Equestrian Center

services.name: Horse Boarding
services.desc: Elysian Fields Equestrian Center is a beautiful, hilltop placed, 40-acre, 24/7, full-access horse boarding and horseback riding, training and lesson facility located 5 miles North from Walmart in Montoursville, PA. Stalls are 12 x 12 and 12 x 15 and normally mucked at least twice a day at minimum. Our arena is Huge with an upper level and lower level viewing area with tables and chairs for spectators to relax and enjoy.
